summary: Expose and reconcile legacy skipped Planfile tickets in queue reads

delivery.outcome: Keep legacy skipped and unknown Planfile records visible in Koru read-only queue and context reports, with explicit migration evidence and no implicit writes.
nonGoals: No automatic mutation or deletion of Planfile records
No rewrite of Koru operational event history
No change to runnable status selection for skipped tickets

architecture.decision: Merge Planfile CLI results with a raw, read-only YAML snapshot by ticket id. Keep the CLI record authoritative; annotate recovered legacy or unknown statuses and expose aggregate counts in context output. Queue cleanup uses the same fallback when the legacy CLI fails.
interfaceChanges: context output adds ticket_compatibility read-only diagnostics
architecture.rollback: Revert the compatibility adapter and its tests; persisted Planfile data remains unchanged.

commands: ruff check src/koru/planfile_compat.py src/koru/context.py src/koru/queue_clean.py tests/test_context.py tests/test_queue_clean.py
validation.evidence: Focused regression tests, lint and governance output retained in the delivery receipt.
